steps.content:
Based on those two pages alone, there is **no material difference** between the sellers - you can buy from either.

Here's what I found when I checked both listings:

**Both listings are for:**
Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite

| | **Seller A - Ottervale Audio** | **Seller B - Brackmoor Sound** |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In the box** | Same - 40h battery, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, carry case, etc. | Same - 40h battery, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, carry case, etc. |

Sold and shipped by the respective store in both cases, so there's no third-party marketplace difference listed either.

### Why either is fine:

Price, rating, shipping speed/cost, return policy, warranty, and product specs are identical as listed. There's no objective reason to prefer A over B from just these pages.

If you want a tie-breaker, I'd check outside these listings:
1. Is one an authorized Quellwyn retailer?
2. Do you have past experience with Ottervale Audio vs Brackmoor Sound?
3. External reviews / customer service reputation for the seller

If you don't have a preference on those, flip a coin - you'll get the same deal at $129 either way.
